languageModelTools.name: axiora_web_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the web. Returns titles, URLs, snippets.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_web_fetch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a URL and return its readable text (article/main content) and links.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_browser
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Drive a real browser. action: goto(url) | click(n|selector|text) | fill(n|selector|text, value) | press(key) | select | check | back | text | snapshot | screenshot | assert(text) | close. Returns numbered interactive elements.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_browser_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Give a multi-step goal to the browser agent (it navigates, clicks, fills forms) and get the result + final screenshot.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_make_document
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create an office file. kind: xlsx|docx|pptx|pdf. spec: {title, blocks:[{heading}|{text}|{bullets:[]}|{table:[[...]]}|{chart:{type,title,labels,series:[{name,values}]}}|{image}], sheets:[{name,rows}], slides:[{title,bullets,chart,image,notes}]}

languageModelTools.name: axiora_make_chart
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Render a chart to PNG + SVG. chart: {type:bar|line|pie, title, labels:[], series:[{name, values:[]}]}

languageModelTools.name: axiora_generate_image
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate an image from a text prompt; saved in the project.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_screenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Capture the editor window (or whole screen) and show it in chat.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_draft_message
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Prepare an email (gmail) or Slack message as a DRAFT card. It is never sent automatically; the user reviews and clicks Send.

languageModelTools.name: axiora_run_shell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command in the workspace (destructive commands need user approval).

languageModelTools.name: axiora_delete_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete a file in the workspace (requires user approval).
